name: alice
description: A long, realistic romance narrative about a woman moving on from a breakup and possibly toward someone new. Readers moved through the story sentence by sentence and, at choice points, saw two options but had to continue along a path that was already fixed for them (they did not control the plot). Afterward they typed everything they could remember.
source: Li, X., Ni, N. K., Born, S., Gualano, R. J., Lee, I., Bellana, B., & chen, j. (2024, December 5). Agency personalizes episodic memories. https://doi.org/10.31234/osf.io/7evwj
